mapper.sql: s.PARKING_SPACE_ID AS "parkingSpaceId", f.FLOOR_NO AS "floorNo", f.FLOOR_NAME AS "floorName", z.ZONE_CODE AS "zoneCode", s.SPACE_NUMBER AS "spaceNumber", s.SPACE_TYPE_CODE AS "spaceTypeCode", s.SPACE_STATUS_CODE AS "spaceStatusCode", s.X_POSITION AS "xPosition", s.Y_POSITION AS "yPosition", s.WIDTH AS "width", s.HEIGHT AS "height", (TO_CHAR(f.FLOOR_NO) || 'F-' || z.ZONE_CODE || s.SPACE_NUMBER) AS "spaceCode", TO_CHAR(s.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PARKING_SPACE s JOIN PARKING_ZONE z ON z.PARKING_ZONE_ID = s.PARKING_ZONE_ID JOIN PARKING_FLOOR f ON f.PARKING_FLOOR_ID = z.PARKING_FLOOR_ID ORDER BY f.FLOOR_NO, z.ZONE_CODE, s.SPACE_NUMBER

SELECT , s.MEMO AS "memo" FROM PARKING_SPACE s JOIN PARKING_ZONE z ON z.PARKING_ZONE_ID = s.PARKING_ZONE_ID JOIN PARKING_FLOOR f ON f.PARKING_FLOOR_ID = z.PARKING_FLOOR_ID ORDER BY f.FLOOR_NO, z.ZONE_CODE, s.SPACE_NUMBER
